title: Vivek Vidyalaya Dispensary Project
summary: During the month ending 31st October 2026, a total of 1,169 students and staff members received first aid treatment at the medical room of Vivek Vidyalaya.
description: During the month ending 31st October 2026, a total of 1,169 students and staff members received first aid treatment at the medical room of Vivek Vidyalaya. The beneficiaries included 12 pre-primary, 192 primary, 712 secondary, 100 college students and 153 staff members. This initiative reflects the continued commitment towards ensuring health, safety and well-being within the institution.
